content:
The activity log records events taking place in your organization's Tenable Vulnerability Management
account. For each event, the log includes information about what action was taken, when the action
was taken, the ID of the user, and the ID of the target entity. The activity log provides visibility into the
actions that users in your organization are taking in Tenable Vulnerability Management, and can be
helpful for identifying security issues and other potential problems.
Use the API to view the activity log for your Tenable Vulnerability Management account.
